item.title: Harassment on Cairo bus revives debate over women’s rights in Egypt
item.description: Police released a man who was accused of stalking and harassing a young woman who filmed her encounter with the suspect on a bus.

item.title: Zelenskiy meets Iranian opposition figure Pahlavi
item.description: KYIV, Feb 13 (Reuters) - President Volodymyr Zelenskiy said he held a meeting with Reza Pahlavi, the exiled son of Iran's last shah and a prominent voice in the opposition, on the sidelines of the Munich Security Conference on Friday. "We discussed the importance of strengthening sanctions against the Iranian regime and any other dictatorial regimes," he said on X, adding that they both condemned cooperation between Russia and Iran. (Reporting by Yuliia Dysa; Editing by Sharon Singleton)

item.title: What’s behind Saudi outreach to Ethiopia amid UAE rift?
item.description: After Saudi Arabia's foreign minister visited Ethiopia earlier this week, its deputy foreign minister arrived in Eritrea on Friday for talks with the country's president and foreign minister.

item.title: Indian writer Roy pulls out of Berlin Film Festival over Gaza row
item.description: Award-winning Indian writer Arundhati Roy said Friday she was withdrawing from the Berlin Film Festival over jury president Wim Wenders's comments that cinema should "stay out of politics" when asked about Gaza.Roy said in a statement sent to AFP that she was "shocked and disgusted" by responses from Wenders and other jury members to a question about the Palestinian territory at a press conference on Thursday.
